title: crataegus × eriocalyx var. villosa
intro: Crataegus × eriocalyx var. villosa, commonly known as the hawthorn variety, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, known for its distinct characteristics and medicinal properties. Research suggests that the hawthorn variety may possess health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and reducing the risk of heart disease due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus × eriocalyx var. villosa are attributed to its vasodilatory, antiarrhythmic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to improved cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids (quercetin, epicatechin), triterpenoids (ursolic acid), and oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
